editorial: Your next binge is a construction site hero who swaps hammers for gadgets. This New Jersey laborer turns an ordinary day into an espionage spree when a long lost high school sweetheart recruits him, blending domestic grit with covert flair. The film has no fuss humor that gives you as much laugh as heart pounding near misses, showing that a greasy thumbs can hide a deadly edge. You will love it if you enjoy a quirky spy adventure fueled by unexpected romance and quick wit. Though pacing limps a bit in the middle, the playful tone keeps the story moving.
targetAudience: Ideal for fans of lighthearted spy comedies who enjoy witty banter and unlikely heroes.
